title: SSC: Seriously Salted Conquest
description: A kitchensink modpack with a bit of everything!
body:
## Disclaimer:

This modpack was made by me, with the help of a friend, to experience an improved version of minecraft with others. There will be no updates, bug fixes, or changes - unless I consider them useful for our playthrough. However, if you like the modpack and want to play it yourself, go for it!

**Java & Memory Recommendation**:
- Jdk 21
- ~16GB RAM (less can work too, just try it out)

## Description:

This modpack aims to add a much greater sense of exploration to the game while still being kitchensink. It features a completely overhauled world generation using Tectonic and many other mods that add tons of Biomes (250+), dimensions (10+), structures and Mobs to make the world feel much more immersive. At the same time, it includes the all-time favorite tech and magic mods to experiment with.

Besides the wide variety of biomes, dimensions, structures, tech and magic mods for progression, you'll find a huge range of new building blocks, decorations, food items and cooking options.

If you want to learn more, just give it a try or check out my Content Overview (or the full modlist) below!

(these mods were removed due to copyright issues, you can insert them yourself manually)
